name: Vendor Risk & Procurement Review Desk
tagline: Reviews new SaaS, contractor, and supplier requests across security, cost, contract, and operational risk before purchase approval.

orchestrator.job: Routes purchase requests through vendor research, security questionnaire review, contract risk, cost comparison, and approval packaging. Blocks payment and contract execution before approval.

agents.job: Captures business need, owner, budget, and required approval path.
deliverables: Captures business need, owner, budget, and required approval path

agents.job: Collects pricing, security docs, status pages, public incidents, and references.
deliverables: Collects pricing, security docs, status pages, public incidents, and references

agents.job: Checks SOC2/ISO claims, data access, SSO, logging, retention, and subprocessors.
deliverables: Checks SOC2/ISO claims, data access, SSO, logging, retention, and subprocessors

agents.job: Compares renewal terms, lock-in, cancellation, hidden usage fees, and alternatives.
deliverables: Compares renewal terms, lock-in, cancellation, hidden usage fees, and alternatives

agents.job: Builds a go/no-go packet with residual risks, required mitigations, and approvers.
deliverables: Builds a go/no-go packet with residual risks, required mitigations, and approvers

reviewGates: Never print private data or secrets
Fall back to safe local drafts on failure
costGuardrails: Use standard or lower for collection and cleanup
Block repeated runs on same input
selfImprovement: Logs run outcomes, failure causes, and user edits into a memory ledger, then updates checklists and eval criteria.
userSetup: Define allowed and forbidden data scope

benchmark.selectionRule: public-safe replacement for a non-public case
